svg.aria-label: Copilot CLI session using the StaticSight MCP tools to review C++ changes
svg.text: GitHub Copilot CLI + StaticSight MCP (illustrative; tool results are real fixture output)

text.tspan: ~/src/cpp-sample (feature)
copilot
> Review my changes. What did I miss, and could anything break?
● staticsight-review_changes
base: merge-base with origin/main (7cd1f773cb)
└ 6 C/C++ files changed (+30 / -1) · cppcheck 1 error · 1 leak path · 2 ignored results · 1 lock cycle
● staticsight-get_branch_skeleton
src/router.cpp Router::process_packet
RETURN -2 early exit; `buffer` (L11) not released on this path
● staticsight-track_struct_risks
Packet
└ 4 sites: socket.cpp:6 send(...sizeof(Packet)), socket.cpp:9, wal.cpp:5, wal.cpp:9 memcpy
● staticsight-track_state_mutations
route_count
Inconsistent locking: router.cpp:34 (read), router.cpp:38 (write) without route_mutex
● staticsight-track_lock_order
(whole repository)
Deadlock cycle: rebalance() takes pool→stats, report() takes stats→pool via drain()
● staticsight-get_upstream_callers
process_packet
└ 3 call sites · listener.cpp:17 and test_router.cpp:6 ignore the int result
Blockers
1. src/router.cpp:13 new early `return -2` leaks `buffer` from malloc at L11
evidence: cppcheck memleak (CWE-401) on a changed line + skeleton. fix: free(buffer) before return,
or move the encryption check above the allocation.
2. src/net/packet.hpp:8 new `checksum` field changes sizeof(Packet); socket.cpp:6 sends raw bytes
and wal.cpp:5/9 memcpy it: wire and WAL formats break for older peers/records. fix: version the
format or serialize per field; add static_assert(sizeof(Packet) == ...).
3. src/router.cpp:34/38 get_route_count() lost its lock and reset() writes route_count bare,
while process_packet/reconfigure_routes hold route_mutex: data race. fix: take the lock.
4. src/net/conn_pool.cpp:31 report() holds stats_mutex while drain() takes pool_mutex: the reverse
of rebalance() (pool, then stats), so the two can deadlock; it also send()s while locked. fix: one order.
Major
5. listener.cpp:17 ignores process_packet() result; new -2 error path is silently dropped.
Verdict: not ready to merge (4 blockers).
First fix the leak at router.cpp:13.
